title: Texas Contractor License: 15 Questions People Ask, Answered
excerpt: Texas has no state general contractor license, but electricians, plumbers and A/C contractors are licensed by TDLR or TSBPE. Here are straight answers to the 15 questions Texans search most about getting licensed. Each answer is short, plain and checked against the official board and exam sources.
author: Max Ace
